I farm rice here near the lake since many years, and this plot of mine gives me food for the family and some to sell. Last season I used one bag of urea and the harvest was not bad, so this year I will do the same, maybe a bit more since I saved some money from the maize on my other plots. I buy the improved seed SARO from the agro-dealer in town because my neighbor got better heads with it, and for rice you must spray once for the birds and the stem borer or you lose too much. My wife and children help me with transplanting and weeding, but rice needs many hands, so I must hire some people from the village during the busy weeks.
